review_target: Final exported 1/3 v1 STL files; not in-memory candidate geometry.
source_comparison: Source v14 STL scaled uniformly by 1.25 and rounded once to float32, matching STL export coordinate precision; both source and final cap moved -0.3125 mm along the normalized rear-cap opening axis for the seated measurement.

unrounded_float64_baseline_ray_diagnosti.explanation: Initial float64 mathematical scaling comparison produced six grazing-ray differences between 0.000054 and 0.000079 mm outside the neck region; the export stores float32 coordinates. The main comparison below uses the same float32 coordinate precision and preserves the raw diagnostic here.

scalp_horizontal_scan.note: Sampled horizontal convex hull is a taut-tape measure, distinct from surface contour. Finite section spacing does not identify the exact continuous maximum.

outer_surface_ray_comparison.limitation: Finite ray sampling complements source vertex and triangle preservation checks; it is not a complete surface distance proof.

neck_radial_wall_samples.limitation: Distance between first two material intersections along outward horizontal radial rays. This is a local support-ring sample, not global minimum normal wall thickness or physical strength certification.

physical_fit: No target body selected and no physical fit or print test performed.
